text:
Lucy Park: Hi folks 44b! Lucy here, first day on developer experience. Laptop is up but I'm getting a persistent keychain prompt during SSO that then fails with 'unexpected response'. Also my Git pushes fail with 'permission denied (publickey)'. Who should I loop in? Also curious if the team has a lunch tradition 35d?

Tess Nguyen: welcome Lucy! I'm your onboarding buddy. For lunch we usually do Taco Tuesday or order in Wed/Thu. Also I'll do a quick 10-min check-in at 1:30pm to walk through repo access.

Ethan Moore: hey Lucy 44b adding you to #devex-alerts. For the git error, looks like your SSH key may not be loaded into the agent. Try `ssh-add -l` and if empty, `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you're on mac and still see keychain prompts, try removing stale SSO entries from Keychain Access.

IT Support: Hi @Lucy Park 4bb if you see 'unexpected response' for SSO, run this sequence and paste the short outputs: `security find-generic-password -s "redwood-sso" -g` then `security delete-generic-password -s "redwood-sso"` and re-enroll at https://sso.redwood.com/enroll. We won't need any secrets here. If you'd prefer we can push a manual re-provision.

Lucy Park: running the first command now, output shows an entry. Deleting and re-enrolling. Also `ssh-add -l` returned nothing so I added the key.

Onboard Bot: Welcome message logged for Lucy Park. Checklist: sso_enrolled: pending, ssh_key_added: true, slack_invite: true, repo_access: pending.

Lucy Park: re-enrolled SSO and the web login succeeded 44d. Trying a git push now... still getting 'permission denied' from origin.

Ethan Moore: if push still denies, check that the public key is uploaded to https://git.redwood.com/settings/keys and that the SSH remote uses `git@git.redwood.com:` format. Run `ssh -T git@git.redwood.com -v` and paste the connection lines (redact usernames).

Taylor Brooks: FYI sometimes corp VPN interferes with SSH host resolution. If you're on VPN try toggling split-tunnel or test from home network briefly. Also we'll add you to the devex-repos group once HR provisioning completes.

Lucy Park: `ssh -T` shows the key used but later says Permission denied. I hadn't uploaded the public key — pasted it to the settings page and can push now 389. Thanks all!

Tess Nguyen: nice! I'll add you to the onboarding doc and drop a calendar invite for our 1:1. For Friday show-and-tell the team brings a small demo or weird hobby.

Lucy Park: fun fact: I restore vintage Polaroid cameras and make cyanotype prints 4f758. Happy to bring photos for Friday.

HR Bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Lucy! Please complete benefits and payroll forms at https://redwood.inference/hr/newhire. Orientation at 9am in #all-hands.

IT Support: Verified sso_enrolled: true and ssh_key_added: true. Repo invites queued; expect them in ~10 minutes. If you hit any more issues, DM support or reply here and we'll escalate.

Lucy Park: everything green now 44d. Thanks for the speedy help and the warm welcome 970! See you at 1:30 and for Taco Tuesday.
